title: Mexico Beats Czech Republic 3-0, Wins Group A With First-Ever Perfect World Cup Group Record
detail: Mexico closed out the group stage of the 2026 FIFA World Cup with a 3-0 win over the Czech Republic at Mexico City Stadium, goals from Mateo Chávez, Julián Quiñones, and Álvaro Fidalgo completing a perfect three-wins-from-three record in Group A. It marked the first time in Mexican football history the national team won all three group-stage matches at a World Cup, eliminating the Czech Republic and setting up a Round of 32 knockout match. The result triggered nationwide celebrations, with fans gathering in plazas across Mexico City, Guadalajara, and Monterrey.
